prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wedding invitation gallery photograph
Primary request: Create a new candid editorial photograph of the exact same fictional couple from Image 1 dancing together beneath warm garden lights at their evening wedding.
Input images: Image 1 is the identity, wardrobe, photographic style, and color reference; preserve both faces, skin tones, hair, age, body proportions, ivory dress, black tuxedo, white shirt, and black bow tie consistently, but create a genuinely new moment and composition.
Scene/backdrop: refined conservatory garden reception at night, warm pin lights suspended high among dark foliage, subtle champagne bokeh, oxblood and black-cherry shadows, no readable signage and no other guests.
Subject: Amara and Julian share a quiet mid-dance turn, close and absorbed in one another, with natural facial expressions and gentle motion in shoulders and ivory silk; both hands are fully concealed behind their bodies or below the crop and must not be visible.
Style/medium: cinematic natural editorial wedding photography, photorealistic, realistic skin pores, fine hair, honest silk and wool texture, subtle film grain, luxury magazine restraint.
Composition/framing: vertical portrait suitable for a tall arch or circular crop; chest-to-knee storytelling crop with the couple centered and faces within the upper-middle safe area; dynamic slight off-axis movement; no visible hands anywhere in frame.
Lighting/mood: intimate warm garden light with cool blue-black ambient separation, romantic but unforced, realistic exposure and deep readable shadows.
Color palette: black cherry, oxblood, muted mauve, ivory, antique champagne; controlled saturation, natural skin color.
Constraints: preserve the exact same fictional people from Image 1; obviously a demo wedding image rather than documentary evidence; anatomically natural; no text, no logo, no watermark, no phone, no visible hands, no extra people.
Avoid: ballroom glamour, bridal catalog posing, plastic skin, over-retouching, rustic decor, daytime light, artificial lens flare, painterly treatment, CGI, identity drift, duplicate faces, cropped heads.
